casebook.jaymoskingdoms.empty: Nothing noticed yet. What you see, and the faces you look at, are written here. Press a note to pin it; press a face to mark it.
casebook.jaymoskingdoms.clue.cellar: An iron hatch in a floor, shut fast.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.tailed.0: Evening, %1$s. Strange, I keep seeing you behind me.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.tailed.1: You were on my heels the other night, %1$s. Why?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.tailed.2: I haven't forgotten you walking after me in the dark, %1$s.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.taker.innocent.0: Can't sleep either? I'm only walking home.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.taker.innocent.1: Oh, it's you. Cold night for a stroll.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.taker.innocent.2: Just stretching my legs. I'll be off to bed.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.taker.innocent.3: Good night to you. Mind the dark.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.unrest.0: I'll not be pushed around by this lot any longer!
speech.jaymoskingdoms.unrest.2: Where are the guards now, eh?
speech.jaymoskingdoms.unrest.3: Years I've swallowed it. No more!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.takers.safe.0: Harvest's coming in well. Nothing to tell but that.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.takers.safe.1: Quiet and good this season. The barns are filling.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.takers.safe.2: If the rain holds off we'll have grain to spare.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.takers.safe.3: Not a thing amiss. Folk are busy with the fields.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.takers.stalked.0: It's been quiet lately. I haven't seen %1$s in days, and no one will say where they went.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.takers.stalked.1: Nobody wants to be out after dark. %1$s hasn't been seen since.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.takers.stalked.2: Funny how quiet the lane is. %1$s's door has stayed shut for days.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.takers.stalked.3: Don't walk alone at night, friend. Ask after %1$s, if you like. People look away.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unrest.0: Mind the glass in the lanes. The other night got out of hand.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unrest.1: Windows smashed, old scores settled, and not one guard in sight. I'd keep my head down.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unrest.2: There was a night when everyone said what they'd been holding in. It's mended slowly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.unrest.3: The whole street was shouting. Even the watch turned its back.
message.jaymoskingdoms.taker.dragged: Cold stone under you, and the dark. Something dragged you down.
message.jaymoskingdoms.lead.tied_off: The rope on %s is tied off on the post.
